subject.title: fix: workspace divergence no longer wedges cloud-worker sessions

question: Does the maintainership accept the fixed keep-local conflict policy and its recomputed-base behavior for attached cloud workers after reviewing a real divergence-and-recovery run?
rationale: The branch intentionally chooses the operator-visible conflict policy and changes recovery semantics across persisted fences, attached workers, and session claims; automated tests alone do not establish that the intended operator workflow is sound.

options.title: Require live conflict recovery proof
options.body: Request a redacted real Gateway-to-worker run covering conflict application, claim release, staged-result inspection, and restart recovery before approving the policy.

options.title: Accept the policy with documented operational risk
options.body: Approve the fixed keep-local behavior without additional live proof, accepting that the first production conflict will validate attached-worker continuity.

recommendation.title: Require live conflict recovery proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted real Gateway-to-worker run covering conflict application, claim release, staged-result inspection, and restart recovery before approving the policy.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged phase-1 staging design and the current phase-2 recovery implementation.
